transcript: This is AgriPulse OpenMic. I'm your host, Jeff Callie. Our guest this week is Ohio U.S. Senator Sherrod Brown. AgriPulse OpenMic is brought to you by Bayer Crop Science. AgriPulse Open Mind continues with Ohio Senator Sherrod Brown. Next Nearly 40% of the food crops grown globally are lost every year to plant pests and diseases. That investment has nearly doubled the spending of their closest competitors. To find out more about how Bayer is working to help farmers fight resistance, visit Bayer.com. This is Agropulse Open Mike. Amidst a frantic pace in Washington, Ohio, U.S. Senator Sherrod Brown spent time with an interview last week discussing the social and financial challenges facing the nation. Brown says the disarray stems from the election.
